title: Copilot PR scheduled CI retry: PR selection lives in retry.yml and per-commit decisions in retry.sh
answers: Where are scheduled CI retries for Copilot PRs selected and triggered?
Why does the Retry workflow only run on weekdays in JST, and how do I trigger a dry run manually?
Which PRs get automatic CI retries: open, non-draft, auto-merge enabled, non-conflicting?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/retry.yml (the Retry workflow: cron 0,30 9-17 * * 1-5 in Asia/Tokyo, plus workflow_dispatch whose dry_run input defaults to true) runs the rerun step, which searches open non-draft PRs authored by app/copilot-swe-agent created in the last 72 hours and keeps those with autoMergeRequest set and mergeable != CONFLICTING.
Rule: The workflow only chooses PRs and passes each head SHA to .github/workflows/retry.sh (`retry.sh [--dry-run] OWNER/REPO SHA`), which makes all per-commit decisions; merge requirements are not changed on this path.
Constraints: Only Copilot-authored PRs are candidates; the file carries a TODO to extend this to other bot and human PRs. Manual dispatches are dry runs unless dry_run is set to false.
applies: Scope: scheduled and manual CI rerun selection for Copilot PRs in .github/workflows/retry.yml and retry.sh; not other automation.
says: Failed pipeline checks on bot pull requests are not retrying automatically over the weekend.
Trigger a test run to see which bot pull requests would be retried.
The automated test rerun process is skipping bot pull requests that lack auto merge.
Why did failed checks stop rerunning on bot pull requests created three days ago?
Automatically rerun failed pipeline checks on pull requests opened by the coding assistant.
search: Scheduled CI retries for Copilot PRs separate selection in .github/workflows/retry.yml from per-commit rerun decisions in .github/workflows/retry.sh. The workflow runs weekdays 9:00-17:00 JST via cron and via workflow_dispatch (dry_run defaulting to true), targeting open, non-draft PRs created within 72 hours by app/copilot-swe-agent that have autoMergeRequest enabled and no merge conflicts. Head SHAs are forwarded to retry.sh, which makes all per-commit decisions without altering merge requirements. This applies solely to Copilot PR rerun automation, running as dry runs unless explicitly set to false.
